prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: three Green Bay Packers football play covers. Image 2 is the STRICT STYLE MASTER: original NFC EAST chunky cartoon sprite sheet. Image 3 is IDENTITY/COLOR REFERENCE ONLY: Packers players are ROW 3 (Josh Jacobs #8, Jordan Love #10, Trey Smack #28). Redraw image 1 with the EXACT exaggerated cartoon rendering of image 2. Its players must be just as chunky, expressive and toy-like as the NFC East sprite figures, never approaching realistic human proportions. Larger expressive sculpted heads relative to torso, shorter stocky bodies, broad chunky shoulders, big hands and boots, simplified smooth faces and hair, cleaner broad color/shadow shapes, premium polished 3D arcade sprite materials. No realistic muscle anatomy, skin pores, photo skin, lifelike human body proportions, painted sport illustration, realistic photographic field background. All crowds/turf/stadium props also stylized 3D game art, not photos. Preserve Packers identities, faces/hair from row 3 image 3, team colors and numbers, opponent Bears uniforms, the running / passing / kicking actions and three DISTINCT winter field settings of image 1. Do not recolor anybody as Eagles or other NFC East teams; image 2 supplies style/proportions ONLY.
MANDATORY STANDARDIZED HELMET RULE, apply carefully to EVERY player in ALL 3 PANELS: Every OFFENSIVE PACKERS player whose FACE is visible MUST have NO HELMET at all: show uncovered hair/head/face, including visible-faced blockers, featured runner, quarterback and kicker. Offensive players facing away with no visible face MUST wear a Packers helmet. ALL DEFENSIVE BEARS PLAYERS MUST wear Bears helmets, even when faces are visible through their facemasks. The kneeling Packers holder faces away: give him a Packers helmet. Remove only helmets on visible-faced OFFENSIVE players, coherently drawing actual uncovered heads. Do not remove defensive helmets. No helmet floating by a player, no headwear on the visible-faced offense.
Keep active football mechanics: cutting runner with tucked ball, diving tackler in a helmet, leaning engaged blockers, quarterback planted throwing stance with one ball at throwing hand, kicker plant foot beside one-knee-down holder, defender jumping both arms up. Use oblique slightly elevated SIDEWAYS view of diagonal field. All near teammates anatomically same scale, faces/head proportions as cartoonish as image 2.
Output must remain ONE ATLAS with THREE EQUAL WIDE 16:10 LANDSCAPE PANELS stacked vertically, overall PORTRAIT ratio 1:1.875, matching image 1 framing. Top rushing, middle passing, bottom kicking, no text labels, no gutters, no added watermark. Keep all main action within each wide panel. Most important: helmet rule and ORIGINAL NFC EAST SPRITE CARTOON STYLE, not the more realistic direction.
helmetRule: Visible-faced offense bareheaded; back-facing offense and all defense helmeted.
style: NFC East chunky cartoon sprite master.
reviewNotes: All three cover panels checked for NFC East cartoon style, helmet rules, football poses and distinct settings.
